typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOTCDerivSettRMURERDepartmentsStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		departmentName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblIntellimatchGLMonthly	source(output(
		department as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupDepartmentLKPTABLE
tblIntellimatchGLMonthly,LookupDepartmentLKPTABLE lookup(departmentName == department,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupDepartment
LookupDepartment filter(!isMatch()) ~> LookupDepartment0
LookupDepartment0 sink(input(
		Department as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Department = departmentName),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOTCDerivSettRMURERDepartmentsStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOTCDerivSettRMURERDepartmentsStaging
